title: Bishop Carl Stanley tips the FBI about Ferrie and Martin

tellings.quote: So Carl Stanley tells the FBI, "Look at these two guys in New Orleans. They're involved in the assassination."

plain: In 1963, a bishop from Kentucky named Carl Stanley is said to have told the FBI, the US federal police, to look at two men in New Orleans, David Ferrie and Jack Martin, because they were involved in the assassination of President Kennedy. The researcher Peter Levenda tells it on Michels's show without naming a source, as part of a wider story about hidden hands behind world events.
